mapper.sql: id, workspace_id, workflow_id, workflow_version_id, workflow_runtime_generation, trigger_type, trigger_event, trigger_key, record_type, record_id, occurred_at, record_scan_after_id, record_scan_upper_id, dedupe_key, status, available_at, lease_owner, lease_until, delivery_attempt_count, last_error_code, completed_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT w.id AS workflow_id, v.id AS workflow_version_id, w.runtime_generation, v.record_type FROM workflow w JOIN workflow_version v ON v.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND v.workflow_id = w.id AND v.id = w.active_version_id WHERE w.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND w.enabled = TRUE AND w.archived_at IS NULL AND w.intake_paused_at IS NULL AND v.trigger_type = 'entity_change' AND v.record_type = #{recordType} AND JSON_CONTAINS(v.trigger_config, JSON_QUOTE(#{triggerEvent}), '$.events') = 1 ORDER BY w.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT w.id AS workflow_id, v.id AS workflow_version_id, w.runtime_generation, v.record_type FROM workflow w JOIN workflow_version v ON v.workspace_id = w.workspace_id AND v.workflow_id = w.id AND v.id = w.active_version_id WHERE w.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND w.enabled = TRUE AND w.archived_at IS NULL AND w.intake_paused_at IS NULL AND v.trigger_type = 'schedule' AND LOWER(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(v.trigger_config, '$.cadence'))) = #{cadence} ORDER BY w.id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow_trigger_outbox (workspace_id, workflow_id, workflow_version_id, workflow_runtime_generation, trigger_type, trigger_event, trigger_key, record_type, record_id, occurred_at, record_scan_after_id, record_scan_upper_id, dedupe_key, status, available_at) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{workflowId}, #{workflowVersionId}, #{workflowRuntimeGeneration}, #{triggerType}, #{triggerEvent}, #{triggerKey}, #{recordType}, #{recordId}, #{occurredAt}, #{recordScanAfterId}, #{recordScanUpperId}, #{dedupeKey}, 'pending', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = LAST_INSERT_ID(id)
INSERT INTO workflow_runtime_workspace (workspace_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE workspace_id = workflow_runtime_workspace.workspace_id
mapper.select: SELECT next_queue FROM workflow_runtime_workspace WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM workflow_trigger_outbox WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND status = 'leased' AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

SELECT o.id FROM workflow_trigger_outbox o JOIN workflow w ON w.workspace_id = o.workspace_id AND w.id = o.workflow_id WHERE o.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND w.intake_paused_at IS NULL AND o.available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND ( o.status = 'pending' OR (o.status = 'leased' AND o.lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ) ORDER BY o.available_at, o.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow_trigger_outbox SET status = 'dead', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = 'delivery_attempt_limit', completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND delivery_attempt_count >= #{maxAttempts} AND ( status = 'pending' OR (status = 'leased' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) ) ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

UPDATE workflow_trigger_outbox SET status = 'leased', lease_owner = #{leaseOwner}, lease_until = DATE_ADD( CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), delivery_attempt_count = delivery_attempt_count + 1, last_error_code = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND delivery_attempt_count < #{maxAttempts} AND available_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM workflow w WHERE w.workspace_id = workflow_trigger_outbox.workspace_id AND w.id = workflow_trigger_outbox.workflow_id AND w.intake_paused_at IS NULL ) AND ( status = 'pending' OR (status = 'leased' AND lease_until < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)) )

UPDATE workflow_trigger_outbox SET status = 'completed', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'leased' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE workflow_trigger_outbox SET status = 'invalidated', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'leased' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE workflow_trigger_outbox SET record_scan_after_id = #{recordScanAfterId}, delivery_attempt_count = 0, status = CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN 'completed' ELSE 'pending' END, available_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6), lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = NULL, completed_at = CASE WHEN #{completed} THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) ELSE NULL END WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'leased' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)

UPDATE workflow_trigger_outbox SET status = 'dead', lease_owner = NULL, lease_until = NULL, last_error_code = #{errorCode}, completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND status = 'leased' AND lease_owner = #{leaseOwner} AND lease_until >= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6)
